2608.21187.title: Anchored Regularized Direct Least Squares (ARDLS): Integrating Established Prioritization Operators for Priority Elicitation in the Analytic Hierarchy Process
2608.21187.paper_summary: Pairwise reciprocal matrices are fundamental to the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a decision-making model. While the Direct Least Squares (DLS) method provides an intuitive mechanism for deriving priority vectors without complex transformations, the DLS provides multiple solutions. Under high levels of inconsistency, such as cyclic contradictions, this non-convexity yields multiple distinct global minima, resulting in unstable priority rankings that critically depend on initial algorithmic guesses. To overcome this structural deficiency, this paper introduces the Anchored Regularized Direct Least Squares (ARDLS) optimization model. ARDLS integrates uniquely determined established prioritization operators, such as normalization techniques, the Eigenvector method, Singular Value Decomposition, Cosine Maximization, and the Pseudo-Inverse Gram Matrix (the closed-form solution of Weighted Least Squares), as theoretical anchors within a regularization penalty. This integration systematically breaks mathematical symmetries, tilting the optimization landscape to guarantee convergence upon a single, unique global minimum. Comprehensive numerical experiments and simulations validate that the ARDLS framework successfully reduces root mean square error among established priority operators, while guaranteeing strict mathematical uniqueness. The proposed ARDLS may be the ideal alternative for the AHP applied to many application domains.
2608.21187.paper_summary_zh: 成對互惠矩陣是分析層級程序（AHP）的基礎，這是一種決策模型。雖然直接最小平方（DLS）方法提供了一種直觀的機制來推導優先向量，而不需要複雜的轉換，但DLS卻提供了多個解。在高不一致性水平下，例如循環矛盾，這種非凸性會產生多個不同的全局最小值，導致優先排名不穩定，這在很大程度上依賴於初始算法猜測。為了克服這一結構缺陷，本文提出了錨定正則化直接最小平方（ARDLS）優化模型。ARDLS獨特地整合了確定的既定優先化運算子，如正規化技術、特徵向量法、奇異值分解、餘弦最大化和伪逆Gram矩陣（加權最小平方的閉式解），作為正則化懲罰中的理論錨點。這種整合系統性地打破了數學對稱性，傾斜了優化景觀，以保證收斂到單一的獨特全局最小值。全面的數值實驗和模擬驗證了ARDLS框架成功地降低了既定優先運算子之間的均方根誤差，同時保證了嚴格的數學唯一性。所提出的ARDLS可能是應用於許多應用領域的AHP的理想替代方案。
2608.21187.author: Kevin Kam Fung Yuen et.al.
